label: On the dependence reading of mode of being, the transfer load moves to the total-cause premise
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. Read 'r is a mode of x's being' as 'x has r in act and has being', the reading supplied by the sentence's own ground ('secundum hoc enim aliqua perfecta sunt, quod aliquo modo esse habent'). Given that nothing has actuality except insofar as it is (7067553d, q.4 a.1 ad 3), every perfection had in act is a mode of being in this sense (791fa216 at this reading), and the total-cause premise 2f6b9eff at this reading is equivalent to: a total cause of a thing's being causes each perfection it has in act. So on this reading 791fa216 is near-analytic and the whole load of universal transfer sits on 2f6b9eff (with 5e281daf). It asserts none of the premises.
